title: SQLite in Production: WAL Checkpoints & Backup Checklist
description: A production-ready operational checklist for running SQLite under high concurrency in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode, executing online checkpoints, verifying page integrity, and streaming compressed backups to S3.

items.title: Enable Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) Mode
items.description: Configure SQLite in WAL mode to allow concurrent readers while a write transaction is in progress, significantly reducing disk I/O bottlenecks and database lock contention.

codeBlocks.label: Enable WAL and optimize synchronization
codeBlocks.code:
PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;

items.title: Configure Busy Handler Timeout
items.description: Set an explicit busy timeout on database connections so that concurrent write attempts wait for locks to clear instead of immediately failing with SQLITE_BUSY.

items.title: Schedule Routine WAL Checkpoints
items.description: Execute online checkpoints periodically to flush dirty pages from the -wal log file back to the primary database file, preventing unbounded log growth.

items.title: Perform Pre-Backup Integrity Audits
items.description: Run PRAGMA integrity_check before taking backups to ensure b-trees, free pages, and indices are completely free of corruption before archiving.

items.title: Use the Online Backup API for Snapshots
items.description: Never copy an active SQLite database file while transactions are running. Use the SQLite online backup API or .backup CLI command to capture a point-in-time consistent snapshot without locking readers.

items.title: Compress and Ship Immutable Artifacts to Object Storage
items.description: Compress the snapshot using high-ratio compression (such as zstd) and stream it to an S3 bucket or compatible object storage with lifecycle retention policies.
